units.source_text: 不過，憑靠我幼時的經驗，我明白了這一點：當女人像剛才那樣痛哭流涕時，

en.t: However, from my childhood experience, I had learned this much: when a woman wept bitterly like that,

units.source_text: 只要給她一些甜食，她吃過後心情自然就會變得開朗。

en.t: if one simply gave her something sweet, then after eating it her mood would naturally brighten.

units.source_text: 另外，二姐節子有時也會領著她的朋友來我的房間，

en.t: Also, my second sister Setsuko would sometimes bring her friends to my room,

units.source_text: 我仍一如既往，公平地逗大家開心。

en.t: and, as always, I made everyone laugh with equal attention.

units.source_text: 等朋友們離去後，節子一定會說一番那些朋友的壞話，

en.t: After the friends left, Setsuko would always speak ill of them,

units.source_text: 諸如「那個人是不良少女，小心點啊」等等。

en.t: saying things like, "That girl is delinquent, so be careful."

units.source_text: 既然這樣說，你不領她來玩不就行了嗎？

en.t: If she was going to say that, why bring her along at all?

units.source_text: 也多虧了節子，來我房間的客人，幾乎都是女性。

en.t: Thanks also to Setsuko, nearly all the visitors who came to my room were women.

units.source_text: 可是，竹一那句「被迷戀」的奉承話還是沒有實現。

en.t: But Takeichi's flattery about my being loved by women still had not come true.
